descriptor: AI talent acquisition platform for recruiters

voice.summary: Sounds like a recruiter who has seen every CV: crisp, human and focused on outcomes. It speaks of people first and technology second.
dos: Put hires and time-to-hire in numbers
Talk about people before the technology
Keep calls to action to three words
donts: No AI hype or robot imagery

taglines: AI that finds the right people
boilerplate: Grow is an AI talent acquisition platform that helps recruiting teams find, screen and hire strong candidates faster, with consultants on hand.

microcopy.error: We could not book that slot, try another
microcopy.empty: No candidates in this pipeline yet

logo.note: A rising peak stands for career growth.
